intro: Micronesia is a federal republic in free association with the United States.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Congress elects the president from its members. Each of the four states has its own government. Wesley Simina became president in 2023.

chapters.title: The Compact
text: US funding under the Compact supports schools and health care.
